result.summary: The page is mostly usable, but there is a clear localization/content bug where a raw i18n key is shown as a section title. A few carousel/card items are also visually clipped at the screen edges, which is minor but affects polish.

issues.description: A section heading displays the raw localization key "home_feed.popular_title" instead of user-facing text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the localization resource for home_feed.popular_title is loaded and fall back to a default language string if the key is missing.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and restaurant cards are partially cut off at the viewport edge, making content feel clipped.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding or peek spacing so partially visible carousel items look intentional and fully reachable.

issues.description: The third "Fastest near you" restaurant name is truncated as "Trattoria Piccol..." due to card width constraints.
issues.suggestion: Allow horizontal scrolling affordance, reduce card width slightly, or ensure titles ellipsize cleanly with enough context.
